# Clustering

We evaluated clustering performance across k = 30–100 using modularity (Q), number of clusters, and stability (ARI). We observed that results were unstable at low k (30), while k = 50–100 gave consistent partitions (ARI 0.72–0.84). Within this stable regime, we selected k = 70 as a representative resolution, balancing interpretability (17 clusters) and modularity (Q = 0.76). Importantly, results at k = 50 and k = 100 were qualitatively similar, supporting robustness of our clustering.
